data.camera: medium shot, shallow depth of field
data.description: 千年中央绝密档案馆幽暗的书架前，莉音靠在金属隔板旁翻阅着古老的记录晶片，手腕上的银色腕表折射着冷光。她低声自语——「世人都以为我冷酷自负……但为了保护所有人，即便成为大家口中的‘大笨蛋’，我也必须做那个背负一切的观测者。」
data.promptProse: Deep inside the secure sub-basement archive of the Millennium Science School, student council president Rio stands under cool recessed fluorescent beams, holding a glowing digital memory chip between slender gloved fingers. Towering brushed-steel server racks, blinking cyan LED diagnostics, and glass data terminals cast sharp high-tech reflections across her long black hair and calculating crimson eyes.
data.title: 调月莉音 · 绝密档案馆深思
data.animaCaption: She examines the old record chip beside the metal archive shelves.
